assets.prompt:
Ursprüngliche Generierung:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate ONE original landscape 4:3 game illustration for WORD IMPOSTER, a social bluffing party game.

STYLE REFERENCES: Image 1 (green chameleon, coral graphic backdrop) defines the approved rounded sculpted 3D cartoon world. Image 2 (raccoon with pointing hands) confirms the same rendering, tactile costume details and clear composition. Match that world exactly: expressive eyes, bold eyebrows, rich bright colors, clean soft 3D volume and shaped graphic background. Refine the hero toward a clever grown-up character rather than an infant mascot. No cel shading, 2D drawing, polygon facets or realistic humans. The references are only style guides, not compositions to copy literally.

STORY: all other players know the SAME secret clue; the central chameleon received NO clue and confidently pretends to know it. Tell that through the contrast between matching clue cards and his blank one, plus comic acting.

MAIN CHARACTER: an original emerald/lime-green anthropomorphic chameleon with a clearly reptilian wedge-shaped head, crest, curved neck and coiled tail. Rounded animation shapes, not photorealistic reptile skin. Head is expressive and large but a little smaller relative to the body than image 1. Lean natural reptile torso, no pot belly, baby cheeks or giant pleading pupils. Each eye has an independent sideways glance, one narrow eyelid and a raised eyebrow. A small lopsided closed-mouth smirk conveys "of course I know" while his eyes quietly search a neighbour's card. Clever, cheeky, quick-thinking, slightly caught off guard; not scared, angry or bored.

CLOTHING: a fitted short deep-plum jacket with a standing collar, burgundy lining, rolled cuffs and two small brass snap buttons, over a simple charcoal shirt. Clearly designed seams and collar shapes; no logos or fussy weave. The jacket fits a reptilian body, no human muscular torso. Small green reptile paws with distinct short curved digits, not human palms.

One paw holds ONE large ivory card toward camera against his upper chest: the entire face of this card is completely BLANK. His other paw makes a restrained conversational open-hand gesture as he improvises a clue. Exactly two arms and two attached paws. His curly tail is visible at a lower edge.

At LEFT and RIGHT edges, only a small part of the other players' forearms enters: an amber feline paw on the left and an original ivory/coral segmented robot hand on the right. Each holds ONE ivory clue card facing the viewer. BOTH other cards show the EXACT SAME simple GOLD KEY pictogram, same design and size. The main card stays empty. Cards are clearly separated and do not cover eyes, mouths or other hands. No text or additional symbols on any card.

COMPOSITION: close, slightly asymmetric waist-up framing. The chameleon's face and blank card dominate. His gaze, blank card and two identical clue cards form one clear visual triangle, grouped within the central 75% so the image survives an 8:5 banner crop and reads at 136x104 thumbnail size. All important cards fully within the frame. Little empty space. Strong uncluttered silhouette and spontaneous acting.

BACKGROUND: saturated coral and warm tangerine with just two broad darker coral curved shapes, like the reference's graphic backdrop. Dimensional softly lit character against a simple shaped color field. Clean neutral soft key light, gentle warm edge, no cinematic gold haze, purple lounge, furniture or table. No motion rays needed; the props and face tell the story.

Render polished rounded 3D animation, controlled material detail and pleasing soft volume. No photographic pores, excessive scales, gritty textures, hyperrealistic hair, plasticky shine, huge wet doll eyes, baby proportions, glitter, bokeh, fog, bloom, silhouettes of bystanders, floating signs or symbols. No words, letters, numerals, logos, watermarks, app UI, phones, alcohol, drinking vessels, weapons or recognizable franchise characters. ONE finished illustration only, no collage or style sheet.

Gezielte Augen-Korrektur:
Edit the attached Word Imposter illustration. Make a PRECISE LOCAL CORRECTION TO THE EYES ONLY.

Visible error: the SMALLER EYE ON THE VIEWER'S RIGHT currently contains TWO separate dark irises/pupils, one at each end of its white eyeball. This must become ONE anatomically coherent eye with exactly ONE brown iris and exactly ONE black pupil. Remove the duplicated dark iris/pupil at the far RIGHT edge of that eyeball and reconstruct clean continuous ivory-white sclera in its place. There must be no black remnant, extra eye, pupil, iris, eye socket or dark oval in that corner.

The larger eye on the viewer's left already has ONE pupil. Keep that eye's design and size. Align the corrected right eye naturally with it: both eyes glance slightly toward the viewer's LEFT, with one iris/pupil per eye and a single restrained white catchlight per pupil. The character must have exactly TWO eye sockets, TWO eyeballs, TWO irises and TWO pupils in total, arranged as one normal cartoon pair. No independently wandering/crossed gaze or duplicate reflections that look like extra pupils. Keep the clever, mildly half-lidded and cheeky expression.

Preserve everything else exactly: head and eyebrow shapes, emerald skin and crest, plum jacket and charcoal shirt, grin, curled tail, green paws, blank central card, two identical gold-key cards at the edges, tiger paw, robot hand, coral-orange graphic background, lighting, camera, composition, rounded 3D-cartoon style and landscape 4:3 format. No new objects, symbols, text, watermark or other redesign.
assets.notes: Freigegebene neue runde 3D-Cartoonserie: Chamäleon mit leerer Karte und frechem Blick, zwei gleiche goldene Schlüssel bei Mitspielern, eine Pupille je Auge. 800 × 600 Pixel, 34030 Bytes. Einbau nach konkreter Freigabe; übrige neue Serienmotive weiterhin einzeln freigeben lassen.

assets.prompt:
Create ONE original finished landscape 4:3 illustration for the social party game TRUTH OR DARE.

REFERENCE: use the attached illustration ONLY for its NEW Secret Circle animated-comic visual language. Keep clearly DRAWN human faces, bold designed silhouettes, restrained dark contour accents, curved dimensional shapes and two or three clean cel-shaded value planes. This is sophisticated 2.5D animated comedy, with purposeful costume details. No realistic skin/fur/textile rendering. No polygon facets. Change the actual actions and fix the childish goat proportions.

The picture shows TWO grown-up friends taking different challenges during an informal costume-party game, not a stage magic performance. Tight dynamic composition, two distinct actions, mutual awareness, strong personalities.

LEFT — TRUTH, voluntarily admitting a hidden trick:
An original adult human magician around forty, lean shoulders, long distinctive nose, narrow expressive eyes, small angular sideburns and black hair drawn in a few rounded graphic shapes. He wears a slightly rumpled midnight-violet tailcoat, ivory waistcoat, rolled white cuffs with neat buttons, loosened dark cravat. Clothes have visible intentional cuts, lapels, pockets and closures but no fiber texture.
He sheepishly admits how his trick really works: his right hand holds a BLACK TOP HAT tilted toward the viewer at chest level. A large open hinged panel in its side/bottom clearly exposes a false compartment with a simple small CLOTH TOY RABBIT tucked inside. The rabbit is unmistakably a toy: two floppy fabric ears, simple stitched closed eyes, no live animal, no writing. One obvious large flat hinge and open panel, no tiny complicated machinery.
His other hand rests on his own chest in an honest "I admit it" gesture. He looks sideways toward his friend, cheeks indicated with two clean muted pink shapes, mouth in a crooked embarrassed grin. Brows and tucked shoulders communicate candid admission rather than pride in performing a trick. NO mask, floating memory bubble, speech bubble or mirror. Face and revealing hat are large and readable.

RIGHT — DARE, doing a ridiculous but harmless task:
A distinctly ADULT original anthropomorphic mountain goat: long angular goat muzzle, medium curved horns, mature narrow eyes, substantial beard, muscular animal shoulder and chest mass, relatively SMALL head compared with torso, long natural goat hindlegs and cloven hooves. Goat features, furry paws and animal anatomy remain obvious. NO human skin or palms. NO huge round head, baby eyes, chubby belly, tiny legs or cute frightened expression.
He wears a short open burnt-coral biker-style jacket with clear lapels, cuff straps and two practical pockets, over an indigo sleeveless shirt, with his natural fur and goat legs visible below the jacket. No trousers creating a human pelvis, no boots, logos or recognizable existing character costume.
He has been dared to act like an over-the-top rock star using a household BROOM as a pretend guitar. One paw clearly grips the broom's wooden handle at upper chest height; the other paw strums above the broad broom head near his hip. Broom head and bristles unmistakably visible. ONE coherent broom, TWO attached arms and paws. A deep playful wide-legged lunge, torso leaning backward, one raised eyebrow, eyes looking toward the magician and a large cocky lopsided grin. A deliberately silly performance by a confident adult, not a scared baby or a dangerous stunt. No jumping from heights, acrobatics or cushions. Clear motion in pose and clothing, no floating effect symbols.

SETTING: a simple improvised party-game corner in an airy rehearsal loft, NOT a literal theatre show: chalk-green curved wall, a tall burgundy partition, pale cream floor, a single simplified cool window shape. A small physical game-spinner disk with two contrasting colored halves and one arrow lies between them in the lower foreground, suggesting the choice between honesty and a task. It contains NO letters, words or numbers. No audience or crowd. Faces and decisive props grouped in the central 70 percent, the hat separated clearly from the broom. Frame approximately knees upward while showing enough of the goat's lunge and broom for the action to read.

Lighting is clean neutral ivory with lilac shadows and one restrained coral edge accent. Rich controlled burgundy, sage, indigo, coral and cream palette, not golden-blue cinematic lighting. Background quieter than characters. Use expressive animation acting, fluid organic volumes, clean painted/inked shadow shapes and a slightly asymmetric camera angle. Costume details stay precise without photographic materials.

No text, lettering, numbers, question marks, logos, watermark, UI, phones, alcohol, bottles, drinking glasses/cups, weapons, horror or violence. No recognizable film/game characters or near-copies. No skin pores, individual hairs, fur fibers, fabric weave, wet lips, eye glitter, plastic toy sheen, bokeh, bloom or fog. Only this ONE illustration, no collage, comparison board or app mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE finished landscape 4:3 illustration for the adult group party game NEVER HAVE I EVER. No words or text.

REFERENCE ROLES: The two attached project illustrations are STYLE references only: image 1 the chameleon Word Imposter scene, image 2 the magician and goat Truth or Dare scene. Match this SAME polished fully animated 3D world, adult cartoon acting, sculpted expressive faces and eyebrows, tactile stylized cloth, dimensional soft lighting, rich controlled color and original character design. The chameleon image is the primary rendering reference; image 2 reinforces the same world. New cast, setting and action; do not repeat the purple blazer, keys/cards, stage, mask, goat or cushion stunt.

Story: Someone has just heard a "never have I ever" statement and reluctantly admits they HAVE done it, to the delighted surprise of friends. The admission is funny and voluntary, no bullying. Clear readable emotional storytelling.

Main character: an ORIGINAL adult anthropomorphic elephant, seated at center, large in frame, broad ears, medium expressive eyes with dark eyebrows, softly sculpted grey skin, short trunk and NO tusks. A well-fitted chunky burnt-orange sweater with the sleeves pushed up and charcoal trousers. He sheepishly raises ONE open hand beside his face, palm toward the viewer in a clear "yes, that was me" admission. His other hand rests visibly on his own knee. Shoulders tucked slightly in, ear insides and cheeks softly flushed, eyes glance sideways at a friend, crooked embarrassed smile. The trunk curls a little inward below his smile without covering his expression. He has two arms and two hands, both clearly accounted for. Adult proportions, no infant look.

Exactly TWO supporting friends, smaller than the elephant: at left an original anthropomorphic coral-pink flamingo in a faded indigo denim jacket, leaning in with raised eyebrows and an amused open beak; at right a stylized adult human friend with dark curly hair and a short beard in an olive casual overshirt, looking at the elephant with warm surprised laughter and a light conversational hand gesture. They react to the raised hand, not to the viewer. Coherent anatomies, no overlapping ambiguous hands. No finger pointing at the viewer.

A DIFFERENT location: an inviting converted attic games room with a sloped pale terracotta wall, broad blue dusk skylight, low petrol-blue sofa and one loosely draped oatmeal knitted blanket. Warm indirect light, a few broad silhouettes of books and a small houseplant in the background. Clearly shaped colorful room, no densely packed ornaments, no neon. Tight medium framing around the three characters from the seated knees upward. The elephant's expressive face and raised palm dominate the central 60 percent so the admission reads in a small game tile. Natural asymmetrical composition and spontaneous acting. No table blocking the bodies.

Keep the same material richness as the attached images, stylized and animated rather than realistic; warm amber main light with a subtle cool blue dusk fill. A quieter background than the foreground. No memory bubbles, floating symbols, speech bubbles, playing cards, written game statements, visual collage or panels. No alcohol, drinking glasses or cups, weapons, logos, real people, recognizable franchise characters, watermark, text, letters or numerals. No photorealistic skin, wrinkles, pores, baby mascots, plush-toy proportions, huge doll eyes, odd fantasy anatomy or generic glossy plastic. Render only the illustration, no app mockup.
